{{Top|leg}}
'''Phalanx Decode''' was a decryption code used by [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Nain Lup|Karbo Jaxx]]. When arms deals were agreed with Karbo, he would provide the recipient with the coordinates to his [[Karbo's Gun Drop|drop point]] at [[Telega Lake]]. The coordinates were encrypted, and required the Phalanx Decode to unscramble.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
